markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 倒装就是**把助动词（do、have、can 这类）搬到主语前面**，像问句，但不是在提问。常用来附和别人（So do I），或把 never 放句首、让语气更强。

uses.en: — I love this app. — [[So do I]].

uses.zh: 否定词放句首，语气更强
uses.en: [[Never have I]] seen such messy code.
uses.en_zh: 我从没见过这么乱的代码。

uses.en: [[Had I]] known, I would have helped.
uses.en_zh: 我要是早知道，就帮忙了。

soNeither.title: So do I / Neither do I
soNeither.rule: 别人说了**肯定**的，你也一样：**So** + 助动词 + I。别人说了**否定**的，你也一样：**Neither** + 助动词 + I。助动词跟着原句走。

examples.en: — I can't make it tonight. — [[Neither can]] I.
— I've finished my tasks. — [[So have]] I.
— Tom didn't like the film. — [[Neither did]] Anna.
examples.zh: ——Tom 不喜欢那部电影。——Anna 也不喜欢。

notes: 原句没有助动词（I love…），就用 do / does / did 来接：So [[do]] I。
口语里说 Me too / Me neither 也完全可以。

negative.title: 否定词放句首
negative.rule: never（从不）、rarely（很少）、not only（不但）这类词放到句首时，后面像问句一样：**助动词 + 主语 + 动词**。听起来更正式、更有力。

examples.en: [[Never have I]] seen such a messy codebase.
examples.zh: 我从没见过这么乱的代码库。

examples.en: [[Rarely do]] we ((get)) a bug this bad.
examples.zh: 我们很少遇到这么严重的 bug。

examples.en: [[Not only did]] he ((fix)) it, he also wrote tests.
examples.zh: 他不但修好了，还写了测试。

wrong.bad: Never ~~I have~~ seen such a mess.
wrong.good: [[Never have I]] seen such a mess.

time.title: 「刚……就……」和 Only
time.rule: 「刚……就……」用 **Hardly had I … when …** 或 **No sooner had I … than …**。Only after 放句首，**后半句**倒装。

examples.en: [[Hardly had I]] sat down [[when]] my phone rang.
[[No sooner had]] we released it [[than]] users found a bug.
examples.zh: 我们刚发布，用户就发现了一个 bug。

examples.en: Only after the call [[did I]] ((realise)) my mistake.
examples.zh: 打完电话我才意识到自己错了。

time.tip: 配对记：hardly 配 when，no sooner 配 than。

noIf.title: 省掉 if 的倒装
noIf.rule: 正式说法里可以**去掉 if**，把 had、should、were 搬到主语前面。意思不变，只是更正式，邮件里常见。

items.en: [[Had I]] known, I would have helped.
items.zh: 我要是早知道，就帮忙了。

items.en: [[Should]] you need anything, just let me know.
[[Were I]] you, I'd take the offer.
items.zh: 我要是你，就接受这个 offer。

this.en: Never [[have I]] seen such a mess.

that.en: I [[have never]] seen such a mess.

this.meaning: So / Neither：完整的说法，助动词要对上

commonMistakes.why: 否定词放句首，助动词放主语前面。
附和别人时是 So do I。
neither 本身就是否定，助动词用肯定。

commonMistakes.bad: Not only ~~he fixed~~ it, he also tested it.
commonMistakes.good: [[Not only did he]] ((fix)) it, he also tested it.
commonMistakes.why: not only 放句首要倒装。

commonMistakes.bad: Hardly had I arrived ~~than~~ it rained.
commonMistakes.good: Hardly had I arrived [[when]] it rained.

quiz.explain: 肯定句，附和用 [[So do I]]。

quiz.prompt: — I can't make it tonight. — Neither ___ I.

traps.note: neither 已经有「不」，用肯定的 can。

quiz.explain: 原句是 can't，接 Neither [[can]] I。

quiz.prompt: — I've finished my tasks. — So ___ I.
quiz.explain: 原句是 I've，用 So [[have]] I。

quiz.prompt: — Tom didn't like the film. — ___ Anna.
用 Never 开头改写：I have never seen such a messy codebase.
quiz.answer: Never have I seen such a messy codebase.

traps.input: Never I have seen such a messy codebase.
traps.note: never 放句首，要把 have 放到 I 前面。

quiz.prompt: Rarely ___ we get a bug this bad.
改错：Not only he fixed it, he also wrote tests.
quiz.answer: Not only did he fix it, he also wrote tests.
accept: Not only did he fix it, but he also wrote tests.

quiz.prompt: Hardly had I sat down ___ my phone rang.
No sooner had we released it ___ users found a bug.
用 Only after 开头改写：I realised my mistake only after the call.
quiz.answer: Only after the call did I realise my mistake.
accept: Only after the call did I realize my mistake.
quiz.explain: Only after … 后半句倒装：[[did I]] ((realise))。

quiz.prompt: 去掉 if：If I had known, I would have helped.
quiz.answer: Had I known, I would have helped.
accept: Had I known, I'd have helped.
quiz.explain: 把 had 搬到前面：[[Had I]] known。

quiz.prompt: ___ you need anything, just let me know.（正式邮件）
改错：— I love it. — So I do.
accept: — I love it. — So do I.

quiz.prompt: 改错：— I can't swim. — Neither can't I.
accept: — I can't swim. — Neither can I.

quiz.prompt: 翻译：——我累了。——我也是。（用 So）
quiz.explain: 原句是 I'm，附和用 [[So am I]]。

openTask.prompt: 写 3 句话：一句用 So / Neither 附和同事的话，一句用 Never 或 Rarely 开头说一次少见的经历，一句用 Should you … 写正式邮件结尾。
rules: So / Neither 后面：助动词 + 主语，助动词跟原句走
否定词放句首时，助动词放到主语前面
openTask.note: 规则判倒装语序（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
